newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip, though offers slow to fall.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip, though offers slow to fall.

text.p: NWE oil products dippped slightly on Thursday as buying faded though some sellers held out with unchanged offers, dealers said.

Gas oil barges were down about $1 on futures losses. Heating oil offers remained at Nov IPE +$4 fob ARA, but bids moved down $1 to +$2. Diesel supply was seen improving, but sellers still held out above Nov IPE +$30 fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil offers were similar to Wednesday's closing levels, at $126/$127 fob ARA, but bids were down to $125, traders said.
